title: Index.json
description: The common fields in every index.json

fallback.description: Absolute in-drive path to an HTML app shell served (200 rewrite, URL unchanged) when a page navigation misses. Real files always win. Supersedes the legacy /.ui/ui.html convention.

collaborative.description: Whether the drive accepts new writers (multi-writer unlocked). Managed by nomad.fs.configure.

indexable.description: Opt in to public discovery: when true, the drive announces itself for search and may appear in results (ADR-0016). Absent/false means it is never listed. Never set on private, Vault, or Root drives.

topics.description: Up to 5 browsable categories the drive is listed under. Exact-match facets, written as lowercase hyphenated slugs (any script) so independent indexers agree on the same shelf. Scopes search; does not gate listing (see indexable).

keywords.description: Up to 12 free-text search aids, matched alongside title and description. Improves matching only; declaring a keyword lists the drive under no topic. Indexers honor at most the first 12.
